item.title: Baker Bleu: Where Breaking Bread is a Space-Making Ritual
item.description: At Melbourne’s flagship Baker Bleu, IF Architecture choreographs space, material, and graphic clarity to elevate artisan bread-making into a spatial experience of precision, ritual, and warmth.

item.title: Matteo Thun Embeds BASIN Glacial Waters into Lake Louise Landscape
item.description: Matteo Thun's BASIN Glacial Waters is a thermal bathing facility integrating European sweat culture with glacial-fed hydrotherapy.

item.title: Hwang Bishop Debuts Bloom Lighting in Fresh Matte Palette
item.description: Bloom from Hwang Bishop features biomimetic shades that resemble a multitude of structures found in nature – bringing the outside in.

item.title: Take 5: Balloon Flowers, An Interactive Wall Sconce, Magazine-Land + More
item.description: Assistant Editor Sophie Sobol explores an inaugural Take 5 that’s bursting with pattern-clashing and color.

item.title: F5: Amber Pan Talks an Amsterdam School Lamp, a Favorite Book, Sculptures + More
item.description: Amber Pan, co-founder of Studio ?MA, shares her love of a designer chair, an Amsterdam School lamp, favorite sculptures, and more.

item.title: Motorola Commemorates the 2026 World Cup With a Re-styled Razr
item.description: Cast in geometric shapes of field green, the special edition mobile phone marks the global event in vibrant color and texture.

item.title: VARMBLIXT by Sabine Marcelis for IKEA Expands Further
item.description: The VARMBLIXT donut lamp from IKEA is everywhere – designed by Sabine Marcelis, a smart update allows for a whole new level of light control.

item.title: Desktop Wallpaper: March 2026 with Giorgio Cecatto
item.description: Blending architectural rigor with machine-driven line work, Giorgio Cecatto's Desktop Wallpaper for this month extends early 20th-century industrial abstraction into a contemporary algorithmic language.

item.title: This Compact Space Heater Pays its Users
item.description: The game-changing Heatbit Maxi and Maxi Pro switch out traditional coils for new computational hardware that simultaneously mines bitcoin and heats up it surroundings.

item.title: The Inchiostri Exhibition by Ronan Bouroullec and Giorgio Mastinu
item.description: The Inchiostri Exhibition features solid blocks of Murano glass, available in eleven different colors for limitless combinations.
